notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi, I just made a small patch to address a couple of issues.

Selected language now saves properly so you don't need to keep selecting it every time you start the game.

The "Wave of Mutilation" achievement is fixed, so it should pop when you kill a boss with the Wave gun.

Thanks!

Graeme
